title: Coefficient coherence for a single nested open square
statement: Let gprime:Xprime→X be a scheme morphism, W⊆U opens with inclusion k, and N in D(X). Write r:pullback(gprime,W.ι)→pullback(gprime,U.ι) for relativeMVOpenLift, qW,pW,qU,pU for the second and first pullback projections. Use the fixed derived pullback comparisons of def-pc-relative-mv-maps. Let c:LU.ι⋙Lk≅LW.ι and cprime:LpU⋙Lr≅LpW be comparison followed by the open-composite and first-projection equalities. Let s_N:LqU LU.ι N→LpU Lgprime N and t_N:LqW LW.ι N→LpW Lgprime N be the canonical coefficient-square components. Let d:Lk⋙LqW≅LqU⋙Lr be comparison for qW,k, transport along (r≫qU=qW≫k).symm, and inverse comparison for r,qU. Then LqW(c.hom_N)≫t_N = d.hom_(LU.ι N)≫Lr(s_N)≫cprime.hom_(Lgprime N). No adjunction, direct image or counit appears. The five comparison arguments are supplied explicitly, with hypotheses equating c,cprime,d and every component of s,t to these exact canonical formulas; these equations pin the comparisons and add no mathematical restriction.

proof.text: Substitute the five defining equations for the explicit comparison arguments. Specialize coefficient_square_coordinate_change to the opens W⊆U: g=gprime, v=W.ι, z=U.ι, t=qW, s=pW, qz=qU, pz=pU, e=X.homOfLE i and b=relativeMVOpenLift gprime i. Scheme.homOfLE_ι proves e≫z=v; pullback.lift_snd and lift_fst prove both coordinate equalities; pullback.condition.symm proves both square equalities. Choose Kprime=Lgprime N and phi=identity.

proof.text: Remove LpW(identity) and LpU(identity) by Functor.map_id. Expand the hom components of c,cprime,d by Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app and eqToHom_app, and reassociate. Equality-transport proofs with the same endpoints agree by proof irrelevance. These component formulas give exactly the asserted equality, with no direct image, adjunction counit or base-change mate. Empty schemes, equal opens and the zero coefficient object need no separate case because none of the identities assumes a nonzero object or proper inclusion.

theorem relativeMV_open_square_coefficient_coherence
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) (W U : X.Opens) (i : W ≤ U)
    (c : derivedPullback U.ι ⋙ derivedPullback (X.homOfLE i) ≅ derivedPullback W.ι)
    (c' : derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι) ⋙
      derivedPullback (relativeMVOpenLift g' i) ≅ derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι))
    (s : ∀ N : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).obj ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj N) ⟶
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj ((derivedPullback g').obj N))
    (t : ∀ N : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' W.ι)).obj ((derivedPullback W.ι).obj N) ⟶
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι)).obj ((derivedPullback g').obj N))
    (d : derivedPullback (X.homOfLE i) ⋙ derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' W.ι) ≅
      derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) ⋙ derivedPullback (relativeMVOpenLift g' i))
    (hc : c = relativeMVComp (X.homOfLE i) U.ι ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun k ↦ derivedPullback k) (Scheme.homOfLE_ι X i)))
    (hc' : c' = relativeMVComp (relativeMVOpenLift g' i) (pullback.fst g' U.ι) ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun k ↦ derivedPullback k) (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _)))
    (hs : ∀ N, s N = (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' U.ι) U.ι).hom.app N ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj N)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := U.ι)).symm) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' U.ι) g').inv.app N)
    (ht : ∀ N, t N = (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' W.ι) W.ι).hom.app N ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj N)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := W.ι)).symm) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' W.ι) g').inv.app N)
    (hd : d = relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' W.ι) (X.homOfLE i) ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun k ↦ derivedPullback k)
        (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _).symm) ≪≫
      (relativeMVComp (relativeMVOpenLift g' i) (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).symm) :
    ∀ N : schemeDerivedCategory X,
    (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' W.ι)).map (c.hom.app N) ≫ t N =
      d.hom.app ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj N) ≫
        (derivedPullback (relativeMVOpenLift g' i)).map (s N) ≫
        c'.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj N)
